title: BIGGS Wellness Run 2026 Review: Legazpi's Mayon-Volcano Backdrop 21K
seo_title: BIGGS Wellness Run 2026 Review | Legazpi Philippines Race
meta_description: BIGGS Wellness Run 2026: August 16 at Penaranda Park, Legazpi City. A half marathon with the Mayon Volcano as your backdrop. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at Penaranda Park in Legazpi City, Albay, this BIGGS Inc.-organised wellness run offers three distances. A Bicol road race with the perfect-cone Mayon Volcano as backdrop.
verdict: The BIGGS Wellness Run brings a road race to Legazpi City — the capital of Albay in the Bicol region, best known for the Mayon Volcano with its nearly perfect cone shape dominating the skyline. Organised by BIGGS Inc., three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). Penaranda Park provides a central city venue. August in Bicol is the wet season — expect warm, humid conditions with possible rain. For runners wanting a Philippine half marathon with one of the country's most iconic backdrops, this is a unique pick.

sections.heading: Mayon Volcano: Nature's Perfect Cone
paragraphs: Legazpi City sits at the foot of Mayon Volcano — arguably the world's most perfectly-shaped volcanic cone. [1] A road race here has a backdrop that few races anywhere can match. BIGGS Inc. (a Bicol-based food chain) brings local brand character to the event.

faqs.answer: 16 August 2026 at Penaranda Park, Legazpi City, Albay. It offers 42.2K, 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is listed as not yet announced. BIGGS Inc. organises the event. Mark it on your calendar if you're planning your racing year around it. [1]
